user_cargo_caixas.name: user_cargo_caixas
user_cargo_caixas.value:
case "user"."role"::text
        when 'SDR' then "user"."can_prospect" and not "user"."can_close"
        when 'CLOSER' then "user"."can_close" and not "user"."can_prospect"
        when 'ACOMPANHAMENTO' then not "user"."can_prospect" and not "user"."can_close"
        else true end

leads_source_other_check.name: leads_source_other_check
leads_source_other_check.value: "leads"."source_other" is null or ("leads"."source" = 'OUTRO' and char_length("leads"."source_other") between 1 and 80)

leads_payment_check.name: leads_payment_check
leads_payment_check.value: "leads"."payment_amount_cents" is null or ("leads"."payment_product_id" is not null and "leads"."payment_amount_cents" > 0)

leads_payment_entry_check.name: leads_payment_entry_check
leads_payment_entry_check.value: "leads"."payment_entry_cents" is null or ("leads"."payment_amount_cents" is not null and "leads"."payment_entry_cents" > 0 and "leads"."payment_entry_cents" < "leads"."payment_amount_cents")

leads_lost_reason_other_check.name: leads_lost_reason_other_check
leads_lost_reason_other_check.value: "leads"."lost_reason_other" is null or ("leads"."lost_reason" = 'OUTRO' and char_length("leads"."lost_reason_other") between 1 and 80)

payment_receipt_pair.name: payment_receipt_pair
payment_receipt_pair.value: ("payments"."paid_at" is null) = ("payments"."paid_by" is null) and ("payments"."paid_at" is null) = ("payments"."receipt_key" is null)

playbook_lengths.name: playbook_lengths
playbook_lengths.value: char_length("playbook_scripts"."title") between 1 and 200 and char_length("playbook_scripts"."body") between 1 and 10000

lgpd_resolution_pair.name: lgpd_resolution_pair
lgpd_resolution_pair.value: ("lgpd_requests"."status" = 'OPEN') = ("lgpd_requests"."resolved_at" is null) and ("lgpd_requests"."resolved_at" is null) = ("lgpd_requests"."resolved_by" is null)
